**1 — Scene:** Four large sushi rolls with a small mixed salad, soy sauce, and a pale dressing. I’m estimating the food on the main tray; the separate toast plate at the right and the beverages are excluded.

**2 — Vessels:** Sushi plate approximately **24 cm** across: area ≈ **452 cm²**. Salad bowl approximately **20 cm** across: area ≈ **314 cm²**. Condiment cups approximately **4 cm** across: area ≈ **13 cm²** each.

**3 — Items:** Sushi containing rice, seaweed, vegetables and possibly seafood; lettuce, tomato, cucumber and carrot salad; soy sauce; pale dressing. The sushi filling and dressing composition are uncertain.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight and energy:** Sushi is treated as one composite food so its ingredients are not counted twice. Heights are average pile heights.

| Item | Vessel area covered | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Four sushi rolls | 18% of plate | 81 × 2.8 = 227 ml | 0.85 | 193 | 150 | 290 |
| Lettuce | 20% of bowl | 63 × 2.5 = 158 ml | 0.15 | 24 | 15 | 4 |
| Tomato | 14% of bowl | 44 × 1.8 = 79 ml | 0.60 | 47 | 18 | 8 |
| Cucumber | 8% of bowl | 25 × 1.5 = 38 ml | 0.60 | 23 | 15 | 3 |
| Carrot | 3% of bowl | 9 × 0.8 = 7 ml | 0.60 | 4 | 41 | 2 |
| Soy sauce | 100% of cup base | 13 × 0.8 = 10 ml | 1.0 | 10 | 53 | 5 |
| Pale dressing | 100% of cup base | 13 × 1.2 = 16 ml | 1.0 | 16 | 300 | 48 |

The sushi covers approximately **18%** of its plate; salad components together cover approximately **45%** of the bowl’s projected area. No additional air-gap reduction is applied.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **317 g and 360 kcal** is plausible for four substantial sushi pieces, a modest salad and two small condiment portions. The dressing’s oil content and sushi filling are the main energy uncertainties.
